description: Forward an email to another recipient. Outbound guard applies — HIGH severity content is held for review. Pass `wake` to limit which local recipients get a host turn from the dispatcher when this forward lands.

_account.description: Optional. Override identity for THIS call: pass the AgenticMail agent name (e.g. "Fola") to authenticate as that agent. Requires AGENTICMAIL_ACCOUNT_KEYS_JSON to contain a matching key. Omit to use the default identity (AGENTICMAIL_API_KEY).

uid.description: UID of the email to forward

wake.description: Optional. Names of the agents who should get a host turn when the forward lands. Pass `[]` to deliver silently. Omit to wake everyone CC'd.

name: forward_email
